title: iLO 6 firmware v1.64 release notes (synthetic)
install_notes: Update iLO 6 before System ROM when both are part of the same baseline. No host reboot is required for iLO; the management processor resets (about 2 minutes).
text: iLO 6 v1.64 resolves SYN-CVE-2026-1101 (Redfish session fixation) and SYN-CVE-2026-1102 (SNMP agent buffer over-read). Enhancements: faster firmware staging, improved Redfish task reporting. Install order: update iLO 6 before System ROM. No known issues.

title: System ROM U54 v2.32 for ProLiant DL380 Gen11 (synthetic)
install_notes: Requires iLO 6 v1.60 or later. Host reboot required. Apply with the host in maintenance mode.
text: System ROM U54 v2.32 for DL380 Gen11 addresses SYN-CVE-2026-2201 (UEFI variable handling) and SYN-CVE-2026-2202 (SMM call-out). Updates PCIe link training defaults for 25GbE adapters. Requires iLO 6 v1.60 or later; update iLO first. Host reboot required.

title: AOS-CX 10.14.1000 release notes (synthetic)

known_issues.summary: Brief LACP renegotiation (under 3 s) on downstream LAGs while VSX peers run different major versions; resolves when both peers match.

install_notes: VSX pairs must be upgraded one member at a time (vsx update-software). Upgrading both VSX members simultaneously stops forwarding for every dual-homed downstream device. Allow 20 minutes per member.
text: AOS-CX 10.14.1000 resolves SYN-CVE-2026-3301 (management-plane DoS). Upgrade guidance: VSX pairs must be upgraded one member at a time; never reboot both VSX members at once. Known issue KI-CX-0412: brief LACP renegotiation while peers run mixed versions.
